fields.title: Guyana bid-opportunity / project-advertisement record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. List-mode records carry every field returned by NPTAB's public 'get_public_bid_opportunities' API verbatim; detail-mode records (or list-mode with fetchDetail=true, nested under _detail) carry 'get_public_project_advertisement' fields instead -- a different, not-strictly-superset field set (rich-text ad_header/ad_scope/ad_instruction/ad_footer instead of procurement_nature/estimated_value/current_state/regions).

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-json-api (list only), S1-json-api-detail (list+detail, or standalone detail mode), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (zero currently advertised opportunities, or an unknown/unpublished projectId in detail mode) or blocked_or_transient (network/upstream issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error -- often NPTAB's own Frappe backend error message verbatim.

_detail.title: Project advertisement detail
_detail.description: Present only when input fetchDetail=true (list mode). The full-text project advertisement -- see the detail-mode fields below (project_id, project_name, agency, ad_header, ad_scope, ad_instruction, ad_footer, advertisement_documents). Null if the detail fetch failed (_detailError set alongside).

_detailError.title: Detail fetch error
_detailError.description: Present only when fetchDetail=true and the per-project detail request failed for this specific row -- the list fields are still returned.

project_id.title: Project ID
project_id.description: NPTAB's own project identifier, e.g. 'PROC-2026-00425'. Present on both list and detail records.

project_name.title: Project name
project_name.description: Present on both list and detail records.

agency.title: Publishing agency
agency.description: The government ministry/agency issuing this notice, e.g. '31-Ministry of Public Works'. Present on both list and detail records.

agency_logo.title: Agency logo
agency_logo.description: List records only. Observed null on every record seen during recon.

procurement_method.title: Procurement method
procurement_method.description: e.g. 'Open Tendered'. Present on both list and detail records.

procurement_sub_nature.title: Procurement sub-nature
procurement_sub_nature.description: List records only. Frequently an empty string upstream.

estimated_value.title: Estimated value
estimated_value.description: List records only. Observed 0.0 on every record seen during recon -- not populated by NPTAB for these notices, not a parsing gap.

current_state.title: Current state
current_state.description: List records only. Observed value: 'Bid Advertised' -- this platform's public API only surfaces currently-open opportunities, no historical/awarded states.

actual_bid_opening_date.title: Actual bid opening date
actual_bid_opening_date.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD, or null before the opening has occurred. Present on both list and detail records.

projected_bid_opening_date.title: Projected bid opening date
projected_bid_opening_date.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD (submission deadline). Present on both list and detail records.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: List records only. Array of Guyana administrative region names, e.g. ['Region 04'].

advertisement_documents.title: Advertisement documents
advertisement_documents.description: Array of {document_name, document_file, document_url}. document_file is NPTAB's raw relative path; document_url is this actor's derived absolute, percent-encoded, directly-downloadable link. Present on both list and detail records (no login required).

ad_header.title: Advertisement header (HTML)
ad_header.description: Detail records only. Rich-text HTML fragment -- notice title block.

ad_scope.title: Advertisement scope (HTML)
ad_scope.description: Detail records only. Rich-text HTML fragment -- project background/scope.

ad_instruction.title: Advertisement instructions (HTML)
ad_instruction.description: Detail records only. Rich-text HTML fragment -- bidding/submission instructions, qualification criteria.

ad_footer.title: Advertisement footer (HTML)
ad_footer.description: Detail records only. Rich-text HTML fragment -- contact addresses (NPTAB and/or issuing agency), bid security requirements.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across list and detail records.
